title: kb_status gives git 60 s before it reports an installed plugin copy's version as its commit
goal: kb_mcp.git() waits GIT_TIMEOUT_S = 60 s (was 10 s) for each local git call of kb_status and the upstream check, so a loaded host no longer turns a marketplace clone that has the version into 'commit: <version>' with no commit_date and no behind_upstream line (job 16825890140, test_status_says_how_far_an_installed_plugin_is_behind_its_marketplace, which passed in the idle local container: a missing object would fail every run, so the one non-deterministic cause is the timeout).
